name: How long does a typical wind damage roof inspection take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical wind damage roof inspection take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard wind damage roof inspection typically takes between 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the size and complexity of your roof and the extent of visible damage. Discounted Roofing Co. aims to complete thorough inspections efficiently, minimizing disruption to your day while ensuring all potential issues are identified.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical inspection takes 30 minutes to an hour, depending on roof size and damage extent.
